title.zh: 修复新建工程页点击无反应
title.en: Fixes the new-project page whose Create button did nothing

highlights.zh: 新建工程页点击“创建”没有反应：新手引导的遮罩盖在页面上，把点击吃掉了。
highlights.en: On the new-project page, pressing Create did nothing: the first-run tour's overlay covered the page and swallowed the click.

highlights.zh: 引导不再在新建工程页自动弹出，仍可从帮助里随时打开，其它页面行为不变。
highlights.en: The tour no longer opens itself on the new-project route; it is still available from Help, and other routes behave as before.
